title: Play Anatomy and Execution Controls
objective: Build plays and run them with deliberate scope and privilege.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: A play binds a host pattern to variables, privilege settings, pre-tasks, tasks, and handlers. Task names should describe intent so output becomes an operational narrative.
ansible-playbook supports inventory selection, limit, tags, check mode, diff, verbosity, user selection, and privilege escalation. Start narrow and preview risky changes.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Build plays and run them with deliberate scope and privilege.

execution:

  check: true
  diff: true
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
